prompt:
A review row is 12,000 tokens. The embedding model caps at 8,191 input tokens. Search quality is poor on long manuals pasted into `ReviewText`.

What should you do?
explanation: Chunking is an explicit DP-800 skill. You cannot stuff a novel into one embedding without truncation, and dimension ≠ token count. Child rows (ReviewId + ChunkId) keep retrieval granular.

options.text: Chunk the source text (overlapping windows or structure-aware splits), embed each chunk as its own row/child, and retrieve chunks — not one truncated mega-vector
Store the 12,000-token string in `VECTOR(1536)` directly; VECTOR is nvarchar
Drop the VECTOR column and use `LIKE '%chunk%'`
Increase VECTOR dimensions to 12000 so each token is a dimension
